name: odysseus
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Agamemnon instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Agamemnon tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Agamemnon through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Agamemnon Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Agamemnon only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
